theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) ∧ ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → boundaryMassOn T W < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0)) → ((∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid N) k) (τ : Fin k → Euclid N), Orthonormal ℝ τ → |α τ| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ δ a b : ℝ) (F G : Euclid N → Euclid N') (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k) (ηF ηG : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) F → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ X.support, ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ ≤ Λ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ G x‖ ≤ Λ) → (∀ x ∈ X.support, dist (F x) (G x) ≤ δ) → (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) y) ≤ a) → (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) y) ≤ b) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηF : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x)) → (∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηG : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (G x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G x)) → |X ηG - X ηF| ≤ δ * (Λ ^ k * X.mass.toReal * b + Λ ^ (k - 1) * (boundaryMassOn X univ).toReal * a)
